title: AllotNet: an Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts Choice Model for Moral Judgement in Humanitarian Aid Allocation, Validated against a Planted Synthetic Population
abstract: arXiv:2611.23474v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Official development assistance fell by 23.1 per cent in 2025, and the decision of who is helped first when there is not enough for everyone is moving into software. A leading published machine-learning targeting system excluded 53 per cent of eligible households as deployed. If the rule of distribution ends up in code, it should carry the judgement of many cultures, and the machine should execute while a person judges. AllotNet is an interpretable mixture-of-experts conditional logit for the allocation judgements elicited by Allot, a pre-registered six-language instrument: eight linear taste experts over seven ethical criteria, weighted by a gate over participant context, with a damped residual, an encoder for household intake, an outcome head and a budget-constrained planner that builds a review queue and never rejects anyone. A model of human judgement has no answer key on real data, so we wrote one first: a planted synthetic popula

translated_title: AllotNet：一个面向人道主义援助分配中道德判断的可解释混合专家选择模型，并通过植入式合成人口加以验证
translated_abstract: 2025年，官方发展援助下降了23.1%，而在资源不足以惠及所有人时决定谁优先获得帮助的权力正在转移到软件之中。一个已发表的领先机器学习瞄准系统在实际部署中排除了53%的符合资格的家庭。如果分配规则最终被写入代码，它就应当承载多种文化的判断，让机器负责执行、由人来评判。AllotNet是一个可解释的混合专家条件Logit模型，用于学习由Allot——一个预注册的六种语言调查工具——所引出的分配判断：模型在七项伦理标准之上设置了八个线性偏好专家，通过基于参与者情境的门控进行加权，并带有阻尼残差、一个用于家庭信息录入的编码器、一个结果预测头，以及一个构建审核队列、绝不直接拒绝任何人的预算受限规划器。人类判断模型在真实数据上缺乏标准答案，因此我们首先自行构造了一个答案：一个植入的合成人口。
tldr: AllotNet是一个可解释的混合专家条件Logit模型，通过预注册的六语言工具Allot捕获多文化道德判断以辅助人道主义援助分配，其规划器构建审核队列而非拒绝任何人，并通过植入式合成人口验证了模型有效性。
